instruction: Set a soft yellow background for every slide using the Master View.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires applying a soft yellow background (RGB [255, 255, 0]) to all slides using Master View settings. The evaluator uses the existing evaluate_presentation_fill_to_rgb_distance metric to calculate color distance from the target yellow. Original background is white [255, 255, 255]. Verified that the metric returns a score based on RGB distance normalized by maximum possible distance.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly uses evaluate_presentation_fill_to_rgb_distance metric which receives rules dict directly when expected.type='rule'
Metric correctly iterates through ALL slides checking background fill colors (via prs.slides loop)
Properly handles both direct slide fill (type 1) and master slide inheritance (type 5), which is essential for Master View verification
RGB distance calculation is semantically correct: calculates Euclidean distance from target yellow [255,255,0] normalized by max possible distance
Expected values are correct: target RGB [255,255,0] represents soft yellow, original RGB [255,255,255] is standard white background
Postconfig correctly saves the file (Ctrl+S) before vm_file getter retrieves it, ensuring fresh state
Complete coverage: verifies all slides inherit yellow background when applied via Master View
Scoring logic is sound: returns 1.0 for unchanged (original color detected), returns proportional score based on proximity to target yellow
